title: Lightweight Code-First Orchestration for Vertical AI Agents
oneLiner: The OpenAI Agents SDK provides a lightweight, code-first framework to build agents that plan, complete tasks using tools, and hand off work in multi-agent workflows.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: The OpenAI Agents SDK provides a lightweight, code-first framework to build agents that plan, complete tasks using tools, and hand off work in multi-agent workflows.
steps: Define an Agent with specific instructions and tools
Use `Runner.run()` or `Runner.run_streamed()` to execute the agent
Handle the final output or handoff.
configSnippet: "Agent A extracts data using a search tool, then hands off the structured data to Agent B for formatting and email dispatch."
limitations: complex state persistence across long-running tasks may require external orchestration (e.g., Temporal).
